newsitem.title: USA: SBC says wireless penetration at 10.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: SBC says wireless penetration at 10.1 pct.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc said on Thursday it added 164,000 wireless-telephony customers in the third quarter, lifting its market penetration to 10.1 percent.
The company said in its earnings report that it was the first major U.S. wireless-telephony group to reach more than 10 percent market penetration.
SBC chief executive Edward Whitacre said the company has 4.1 million domestic wireless customers through its Southwestern Bell and Cellular One brands.
"Taken together, our wireline and wireless businesses achieved a net gain of 1.46 million customer lines during the last 12 months," Whitacre said.
SBC said revenues at its Southwestern Bell telephone operations increased 8.5 percent for the quarter.

Access lines at the end of the quarter totaled 14.8 million, with strong growth in both residential and business access lines. Over the last year, residential access lines rose 3.7 percent and business lines grew 8.4 percent.
SBC's third-quarter earnings increased 11.0 percent to 3 million, or $0.97 a share, from $534.3 million, or $0.88 a share, before an extraordinary charge a year ago.
